purpose: Let the Xiaomi camera load the native libraries of its downloadable modes

problem.symptom: In the Xiaomi camera, the extra modes never install. Every Qigsaw module directory under /data/data/com.android.camera/app_qigsaw/5.0.0.0 exists and is empty.
problem.cause: The split downloads and unpacks correctly, then dlopen() of its first native library fails with 'couldn't map ... segment 2: Permission denied' and Qigsaw deletes the whole module. The camera is platform-key signed, so it runs as platform_app with data labelled app_data_file, and the policy grants that pair every file permission except execute.

evidence.linker: dlopen failed: couldn't map "/data/data/com.android.camera/app_qigsaw/5.0.0.0/panorama/8.4.1@17/nativeLib/arm64-v8a/libmorpho_sensor_fusion.so" segment 2: Permission denied
evidence.rollback: MCAM_Split.FileUtil: Succeed to delete file: ... /panorama/8.4.1@17/panorama.apk, then nativeLib, oat and the version directory itself
evidence.no_audit_record: no avc denial is logged for this: the platform policy carries a dontaudit for app data execute, so the only visible symptom is the linker message
evidence.policy_query: /sys/fs/selinux/access for u:r:platform_app:s0:c512,c768 -> u:object_r:app_data_file:s0:c512,c768 class file returns allowed=0x1142e7f, which grants append create getattr ioctl lock map open read rename setattr unlink watch watch_reads write and withholds execute

scope_and_cost.grants: execute on app_data_file to every platform-key-signed app
scope_and_cost.execmod_not_needed_because: none of the nine libraries in the panorama split declares DT_TEXTREL or the TEXTREL flag
scope_and_cost.neverallow_review: no AOSP neverallow covers it: the app data execute neverallows name all_untrusted_apps, and the sensitive-domain list in private/app.te (bluetooth, isolated_app_all, nfc, radio, shared_relro, sdk_sandbox_all, system_app) does not include platform_app
scope_and_cost.types_are_public: platform_app is declared in system/sepolicy/public/platform_app.te and app_data_file in public/file.te, so product-private policy may add this rule

rejected_alternatives.private_data_type_for_the_camera: a seapp_contexts type= of its own would scope the grant to one app, but many platform rules name app_data_file literally rather than the app_data_file_type attribute, so the camera would silently lose access it has today
rejected_alternatives.private_domain_for_the_camera: would have to re-derive every permission platform_app grants it
rejected_alternatives.ship_the_splits_in_the_image: the splits are not in the APK and it is Xiaomi-signed, so it cannot be repacked; Qigsaw unpacks to the same data directory either way

remaining: On-device confirmation that a mode installs and runs
Whether any module needs a permission beyond execute once its libraries load
The other six modules were never observed downloading; only panorama was exercised
